Current skill text describes priority tiers but code pattern in draft takes first-matching tier and 'last number on that line' — on OCR'd 074 the Net Total line may lose its number or be split, and fallback picked an unrelated number (e.g., '702' from OCR garbage or merged digits)."},{"id":"R2","maps_to":["F2"],"description":"Skill does not treat 'Rounding Adj' / 'Total After Rounding' / final 'TOTAL:' as highest-priority when a pre-rounding 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' line precedes it.
